text:
Ethan Park: Heads-up — AtlasGrid RFP just landed. They want a capability matrix + security answers and a 4-week POC plan by EOD Monday. Can we pull this together?
Saanvi Rao: On it. I'll start the capability matrix and call out Dedicated vs Private options.
Markus Li: Do we have a recent cost comparison for reserved capacity vs hosted for steady 250k tokens/day? Need numbers for pricing sheet.
Samir - Sales Ops: I can run numbers. Quick Q: are they expecting volume discounts up front or performance SLAs in the POC?
Ethan Park: They asked for both — volume tier pricing + SLA targets (p95 latency < 300ms for 512 tokens). Also want fallback plan if capacity is constrained.
Priya Sethi: For the security questionnaire they flagged: KMS/HSM usage, SOC2 Type II, data residency in eu-west-1, and audit logging retention. I have our SOC2 cert but need details on KMS flow for Private.
Legal Ops Bot: FYI — redlines we usually push back on: indemnity cap, data ownership, and export controls. If AtlasGrid needs HSM attestation, we'll coordinate with infra for evidence.
Markus Li: Samir — run two price decks: hosted pay-as-you-go and a 12-month reserved capacity commit with 20% discount. Include estimated egress.
Samir - Sales Ops: Will do. ETA 3 hours.
Saanvi Rao: Capability matrix draft: 1) model catalog compatibility, 2) streaming & function calls, 3) encryption at-rest/in-transit, 4) VPC peering & private control plane, 5) rollout policies, 6) observability retention tiers.
Ethan Park: Nice. Add POC acceptance criteria: latencies, throughput (concurrent requests), correctness on 5 canonical prompts, and success regression rate < 2%.
Priya Sethi: For KMS flow in Private: our control plane in customer VPC integrates with customer-managed KMS; keys never leave KMS and we use envelope encryption. I'll paste snippet for the questionnaire: ``Customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS or HSM) with envelope encryption; keys remain under customer control; we support Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) workflows and HSM-backed CMKs.``
Markus Li: Can dev team provision a small Dedicated pool for the POC (2xA10G equiv) in eu-west-1 for 4 weeks? Need perf numbers against their 512-token profile.
DevOps Bot: Provision request received: env=poc-atlasgrid, region=eu-west-1, gpu_pool=2xA10G, ttl=28d. ETA 18-24h.
Priya Sethi: Also attach our latest penetration test summary and SOC2 link: https://redwood.internal/certs/soc2-2025.pdf
Ethan Park: Great — Samir, once pricing is in, I'll assemble the RFP bundle. @Legal Ops any urgent comments before we send the security answers?
Legal Ops Bot: Send the draft Q&A and I'll check redlines. If they request HSM attestation beyond standard doc, we might need infra signoff which can add 2-3 business days.
Samir - Sales Ops: Pricing sent to thread: hosted = $0.0008/token gen, reserved = committed $9,500/mo for 12 months (estimate incl. 20% discount). I'll attach spreadsheet in the RFP packet.
Saanvi Rao: One more ask from the buyer: can we support timebox canary rollouts and automatic fallback to smaller model for degraded infra? We should call that out.
Ethan Park: Yes we do. I'll call it out under resiliency — model routing policies with automatic fallback to verified smaller variants.
Markus Li: After provisioning, I'll run perf tests and post a short log snippet here with p95/p99 numbers.
DevOps Bot: Perf job queued: job_id=pg-4312, profile=512_tokens, requested=2xA10G. Expected runtime 45m.
Ethan Park: Thanks all — plan: Samir (pricing), Saanvi (matrix + narrative), Priya (security answers + attachments), Markus (perf results), Legal (contract check). Aim to ship bundle by Mon EOD. :thumbsup:
